title: A screen reader reads the empty chart outline as No data to chart
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. Browser: you use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. Location: you are in a location (workplace) with nothing in it: no work order, invoice, credit or clocked time (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).
  4. Browser: you have a screen reader. On a Mac use VoiceOver, which is built in: press Command + F5 to turn it on or off. On Windows use NVDA (free from nvaccess.org): install it, start it with Ctrl + Alt + N, and stop it with Insert + Q.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu with ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop selected.
  2. Turn the screen reader on.
  3. Move through the Billing Efficiency tile one item at a time: on a Mac press Control + Option + Right Arrow, on Windows with NVDA press the Down Arrow.
  4. Listen to what is read when you reach the empty-chart outline.
  5. Do the same on the Revenue tile.
  6. Turn the screen reader off.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 4 and 5: When you reach the outline, the screen reader says "No data to chart" (on both tiles).
  • Steps 4 and 5: It does not read the outline as an unlabelled image, a graphic or nothing at all.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 4. The design board shows the outline only as a picture; the spoken text comes from the PRD alone.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R17: “A screen reader reads the placeholder as "No data to chart".”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026.
